Madurai Kamaraj University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Madurai Kamaraj University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Guest Faculty at Madurai Kamaraj University.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Essential qualifications include M.Sc. Film and Electronic Media Studies, M.A. Journalism and Mass Communication, M.Sc. Visual Communication, or any other relevant Postgraduate Degree in the discipline, fulfilling UGC eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any preference given to candidates with experience?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates with relevant teaching and/or industry experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: The salary will be on a consolidated pay basis as per University norms.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The venue is Madurai Kamaraj University, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, Pincode 625021.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring their Updated Bio-data, Original Certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications and experience certificates, and a Valid Identity Proof.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Temporary.
